name: ActionBanner
title: Action banner
summary: The one cobalt thing on a view: a full-width banner that says what you can do next, with a disc that shows the action's glyph.

name: Button
title: Button
summary: Pill buttons for everything that is not the page's main action.

name: Chart
title: Chart
summary: A shot drawn as lines: pressure, temperature, flow and weight against time.

name: Chip
title: Chip
summary: A status word in a small tinted box: uppercase mono, one or two words.

name: Dial
title: Dial
summary: The machine's round display inside a web tile: the same tick ring, with one reading in the middle.

name: Dialog
title: Dialog and sheet
summary: A question that must be answered before anything else: confirm a deletion, choose how to save, acknowledge a fault. On a phone it is a sheet at the bottom of the screen.

name: DisplayBrew
title: Display: Brew
summary: The idle Brew screen: boiler temperature as the reading, the profile under it, START as the action, on the split ring.

name: DisplayMenu
title: Display: Menu and sheets
summary: Everything reached from the handle: the mode menu, Profiles, Adjust, the save sheet, Warnings and Information.

name: DisplayModes
title: Display: Steam, Water, Grind
summary: Steam, Water and Grind share one layout: the target between minus and plus on the centre line, the live value above it, and a single ring.

name: DisplayShot
title: Display: Shot
summary: A shot in progress and its result: elapsed time as the reading, phase bars beneath it, pressure and weight as second-rank values, STOP in ink.

name: DisplayStandby
title: Display: Standby
summary: The display at rest: the clock as the one reading, the boiler's residual heat greyed on a single ring, and WAKE as the one action.

name: DisplayStates
title: Display: product states
summary: The display when things are not normal: connecting, Wi-Fi setup, a command on its way, a warning or update waiting, a blocking fault and a firmware update.

name: EmptyState
title: Empty state
summary: What a tile or a page shows when it has nothing to list yet: one sentence about what will appear, and at most one way to make it appear.

name: Field
title: Field, input and switch
summary: Labelled inputs and switches for Settings, the profile editor and setup.

name: Icon
title: Icon
summary: The 53 stroke glyphs of the interface.

name: ListRow
title: List row
summary: One line of a list: an icon disc, a title, a line of mono facts and something at the end.

name: Loader
title: Loader
summary: The sign that the machine is working on something you asked for: three lit ticks stepping round a small ring. It is the display's busy comet, drawn for the web.

name: Menu
title: Menu
summary: A short list of actions on one thing, opened from a button: the "More" at the end of a profile's row, the menu behind the top bar.

name: ModeBar
title: Mode bar
summary: The machine's five modes in one floating pill: Standby, Brew, Steam, Water, Grind. The machine's mode is the `ink` item.

name: MotionDisplay
title: Motion on the display
summary: A simulation of the T-RGB panel running the display's motion: 23.5 steps a second, with the area each frame redraws.

name: MotionWeb
title: Motion on the web
summary: The web's four motions at their real durations: press, select, enter and leave, and a live reading.

name: Nav
title: Nav and top bar
summary: The four pages of the app: Dashboard, Profiles, History, Settings. A sidebar on desktop, a menu behind the top bar on smaller screens.

name: Notice
title: Notice
summary: A message that stays on the page until its cause is gone: the machine is offline, a fault blocks brewing, an update is ready.

name: NumberField
title: Number field
summary: A typed number with its unit inside the field: dose, yield, a phase's duration, a pressure target.

name: SegmentBar
title: Segment bar
summary: A quantity as a row of discrete segments: lit in a tone, unlit in `track`, with an optional target mark.

name: Segmented
title: Segmented control
summary: A pill-shaped choice of two or three: the selected item is `ink`.

name: Select
title: Select
summary: One choice from a list that is too long, or too unpredictable, for a Segmented control.

name: StageTrack
title: Stage track
summary: The phases of a process as a row of bars: done, running, to come.

name: StatTile
title: Stat tile
summary: A reading in a tile: mono label, large tabular numeral with a raised unit, and a segment bar.

name: States
title: States in three themes
summary: Every control in every state, in the three themes. One rule makes all of them, and it lives in one block of `bundle.css`.

name: Stepper
title: Stepper
summary: Minus, a value, plus: for a number changed in small steps, such as a target temperature or a grind weight.

name: TickRing
title: Tick ring
summary: The ring of ticks on the rim of the display, and around the web Dial: lit ticks are the value, a longer ink tick is the target.

name: Tile
title: Tile and cell
summary: The unit of every page: a rounded `surface-1` block on the `surface-0` ground, holding one thing.

name: Toast
title: Toast
summary: A short confirmation that leaves by itself: something just happened, and nothing needs doing.

name: Tooltip
title: Tooltip
summary: The name of an icon-only control, shown on hover and on keyboard focus.

name: WebDesktop
title: Web: desktop dashboard
summary: The dashboard on desktop: a sidebar tile and a 12 column bento grid, with the mode bar floating at the bottom centre.

name: WebPages
title: Web: profiles, history, settings
summary: Profiles, Shot history and Settings: a `title`, then tiles of ListRows or fields.

name: WebPhone
title: Web: phone dashboard
summary: The dashboard on a phone, at rest and during a shot: one column of tiles with the mode bar floating over it.

name: WebStates
title: Web: product states
summary: What the web app shows when things are not normal: offline, a blocking fault, a command on its way, first start, Wi-Fi setup and a firmware update. All six are drawn at 320 px.
